title: Task Decomposition Effectiveness: Does Breaking Hard Tasks Into Steps Improve Weak Overseer Accuracy?

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Direct test of a core assumption of iterated amplification. If decomposition does not help weak overseers, a major scalable oversight approach is undermined. Clear safety-relevant finding either way.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Conceptually straightforward: pick a task, decompose it, measure overseer accuracy on parts vs. whole. Can use existing models via API or small open models. Accessible to beginners with guidance on experimental design.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Single comparison: decomposed vs. direct oversight on one task. Clear deliverable: accuracy comparison table. The main design challenge is choosing a good task and decomposition, but the experiment itself is compact. Fits 30 hours well.
